summary: The custody pilot for FS-GG/.github#4710 (C-J1) is the separate workflow .github/workflows/wasm-custody-pilot.yml, job custody-pilot. It runs only on workflow_dispatch; pull requests run static controls. It executes pilot_sequence from the inline caller in fable-reference-public.yml at the same commit, inside one sudo systemd-run delegated unit (TasksMax=4096, MemoryMax=8G, RuntimeMaxSec=1800), with a 30-minute job timeout, contents: read and no secrets. pilot_sequence refuses unless all of these hold: a same-repository main dispatch, admitted_ref equal to the dispatched and checked-out commit, the recorded admission URL (#4710 comment 6346457201), the pilot workflow identity, and run attempt 1. It then loads the pinned managed-group owner (ac22206, d846dbe1...) and probes containment before any acquisition. It provisions only the browser subset: the 0.19.1 template locks, Node/npm, the stock Playwright 1.63 seed and the five pinned browser archives. Stock host validation runs once per family and is non-fatal. The stock runner likely lacks WebKit's host libraries, and installing host packages is not admitted, so a missing dependency is recorded as host-dependencies-missing for that family while every case still runs. It then runs, as require-empty custody groups under a non-renewed custody deadline, a Chromium library scan (host ldd) and three cases for each of chromium headless-shell 1243, firefox 1543 (content sandbox enabled) and webkit 2359: normal (stock runner plus vite preview webServer), forced (held past a 25 s group deadline) and leader-exit. Each case is classified in custody-pilot.json. A case counts only when its group was contained, removed and had no escape, and completed requires both scans and all nine cases. An exception in one case never aborts the later cases. Evidence is capped at 45 MiB and hashed, uploaded once, kept 30 days. Installed C stays held (RUNTIME_ADMITTED=False, two literal-false steps, custody_gate). Lessons: fresh_environment already owns root/evidence, so the pilot uses root/pilot-evidence. On a single-shot run, a fatal setup gate unrelated to custody would waste the shot, so host prerequisites are recorded rather than enforced. This record describes the source, not a run outcome.
title: Dispatch-only three-family WASM custody pilot is admitted for exactly one run
